messages:
Maria [Support]: Customer report — promo code 25OFF-TRIAL returned success but org balance remains $0. Org: acme-org (org_7432). Redeemed via CLI by dev+trial@acme.com. CLI returned 200 and grant id g_990 in response. Can billing team check?
Ken [Billing]: Copy — can you paste the raw response + grant id and the time it was redeemed?
Maria [Support]: Here — redeem command the customer ran:
```
redwood promo redeem --code 25OFF-TRIAL --org acme-org
{"status":"ok","grant_id":"g_990","amount_cents":15000}
```
Timestamp customer gave: 2026-03-14T09:12:03Z (they said local).
billing-bot: Ticket BL-1243 created for grant g_990 and linked to ledger query job 8794.
Ken [Billing]: Looking at g_990 now. The grant exists but ledger shows entry e_8794 with status PENDING_HOLD. Reason: billing_profile_incomplete. That flag prevents auto-application of promotional credits.
Maria [Support]: Hmm — customer insisted it was a free trial, no card on file. Is that expected behavior?
Sam [Eng-Platform]: We added that hold rule last quarter to reduce promo misuse for orgs without any billing profile. It prevents credits being converted into usable balance until account has a billing profile or admin manual-apply.
Ashley (acme): Oh — we were told earlier the trial would be immediate. We don't want to add a card. Is there a path to get the credits applied without adding payment details?
Ken [Billing]: Policy note: some promo types (marketing grants) require a billing profile to be present before creating usable balance. The grant was accepted (showing to user), but is intentionally marked PENDING_HOLD so it doesn't show in available balance. We can do a one-time manual release if you confirm org ownership and accept T&C.
Maria [Support]: Ashley — can you confirm you are the org owner and agree to manual release? If yes, we can escalate to Billing to force-apply.
Ashley (acme): I can confirm I'm owner (ashley@acme.com). I accept. Please proceed.
Ken [Billing]: OK. I'll request manual release. Sam — do you have the admin path to force-apply credits for g_990?
Sam [Eng-Platform]: Admin UI -> Billing -> Grants -> search g_990 -> Actions -> Override Hold. I can run the internal API: POST /internal/billing/grants/g_990/override-apply {"actor":"ken@redwood","reason":"customer confirmed org ownership"}.
Lee [Support]: Note: leaving audit comment on ticket BL-1243 and cc'ing Ashley.
Sam [Eng-Platform]: Executed override at 2026-03-14T10:05:12Z. Response: {"status":"applied","balance_delta_cents":15000,"ledger_event_id":"e_8794"}.
Ken [Billing]: Ledger updated, hold cleared, balance now shows $150.00 available. Ashley, can you confirm you see the credit in the Console?
Ashley (acme): I see it now — balance jumped to $150. Thank you. Appreciate manual help.
Maria [Support]: Marking case resolved pending customer confirmation. Leaving steps for product: consider clearer UX copy when promo accepted but held — customers think "applied" == usable.
Sam [Eng-Platform]: Filed UX improvement ticket UX-452 to clarify 'Pending hold' messaging on redemption flow.
Lee [Support]: Closing BL-1243 after 48h if no regressions. :white_check_mark:
Ashley (acme): All good from our side. Closing. Thanks everyone!
